text:
ACCESSIBILITY - 1. Accessible Facilities
Accessible Rooms:
Rooms suitable for guests with mobility requirements may be available.

Wheelchair Access:
The hotel provides wheelchair-accessible rooms and areas.

Elevator Access:
Elevators are available for guest access to all floors.

Accessible Bathrooms:
Accessible bathrooms with grab bars and appropriate fixtures are available.

Wide Doorways:
Accessible rooms feature appropriately wide doorways.

ACCESSIBILITY - 2. Accessibility Services
Assistance Services:
Staff can provide assistance to guests with mobility challenges.

Room Features:
Accessible rooms include appropriate furniture and equipment placement.

Bathroom Equipment:
Grab bars, handheld showers, and accessible toilets are available.

Communication Assistance:
The hotel can arrange communication assistance if needed.

ACCESSIBILITY - 3. Visual Accessibility
Accessible Signage:
Guest navigation signage is clearly marked.

Lighting:
Appropriate lighting is provided throughout the hotel.

Audio Assistance:
Audio descriptions may be available for select amenities.

ACCESSIBILITY - 4. Hearing Accessibility
Visual Alerts:
Visual alert systems are available in accessible rooms.

Communication Methods:
Multiple communication methods are available for deaf and hard of hearing guests.

Interpretation Services:
Interpretation services may be available upon request.

ACCESSIBILITY - 5. Other Accessibility Features
Parking:
Accessible parking spaces are available for guests.

Restaurant Access:
The restaurant and dining areas are accessible to guests with mobility requirements.

Public Areas:
Common areas are accessible to all guests.

Elevator Availability:
Elevators provide access to all guest floors.

ACCESSIBILITY - 6. Service Animals
Service Animals:
Service animals assisting guests may be accommodated.

Documentation:
Service animal documentation may be required.

Room Assignment:
Rooms accommodating service animals can be arranged.

ACCESSIBILITY - 7. Booking and Assistance
Accessibility Requests:
Guests can request accessible accommodations during booking.

Special Requirements:
Guests can specify accessibility requirements during reservation.

Staff Support:
Staff are trained to assist guests with accessibility needs.

Contact:
Guests should contact customer service with specific accessibility questions.

ACCESSIBILITY - 8. Important Information
The current hotel knowledge base does not specify all specific accessibility features in detail.

For complete information about accessibility features, contact customer service during booking.

The hotel is committed to accommodating guests with accessibility requirements.

AIRPORT TRANSFER - 1. Service
Private pickup and drop-off between Cairo International Airport and the hotel.

AIRPORT TRANSFER - 2. Prices
Sedan, up to 3 guests with luggage: 2,500 EGP per trip. Minivan, up to 6 guests: 4,000 EGP per trip.

AIRPORT TRANSFER - 3. Booking
Book at least 24 hours in advance with the flight number and arrival time. The driver meets arriving guests in the arrivals hall with a name sign and waits up to 60 minutes after landing at no extra charge.

AIRPORT TRANSFER - 4. Journey Time
The airport is about 25 km away; the journey takes 35 to 60 minutes depending on traffic.

BOOKING CONFIRMATION - 1. Confirmation
A reservation is confirmed as soon as its payment link is paid: the first-night deposit on the Flexible rate, or the full amount on the Non-refundable rate. Until then the room is held for 24 hours, or for 2 hours if arrival is less than 24 hours away. If the link is not paid in time, the reservation is cancelled automatically and the room is released. The confirmation is sent by email as soon as the payment is received.

BOOKING CONFIRMATION - 2. Booking Reference
Every reservation has a booking reference made of the letter B followed by six digits, for example B013193. Guests should keep it; customer service asks for it when a booking is changed, cancelled or checked.

BOOKING CONFIRMATION - 3. Confirmation Details
The confirmation shows the guest name, number of guests, check-in and check-out dates, room type, rate plan, total price and the cancellation terms. For the Flexible rate it also shows the first-night deposit and the payment link.

BOOKING CONFIRMATION - 4. Missing Confirmation
If the confirmation does not arrive within one hour, check the spam folder, then contact customer service with the guest name and dates so the booking can be found and the confirmation resent.

BOOKING MODIFICATION POLICY - 1. Reservation Changes
A Flexible reservation can be changed free of charge until 48 hours before arrival, as long as a suitable room is free. Non-refundable reservations cannot be changed. If no suitable room is free, the reservation stays exactly as it is.

section: 2. Changes to Check-in or Check-out Dates
text:
BOOKING MODIFICATION POLICY - 2. Changes to Check-in or Check-out Dates
New dates need a free room of the same type for every night. The agreed nightly rate is kept. A date change made less than 48 hours before arrival is treated as a late cancellation of the original dates, and the first night is charged.

BOOKING MODIFICATION POLICY - 3. Changes to Room Type
A room type change needs a free room of the new type for the whole stay. The new room type's standard rate applies to the whole stay.

BOOKING MODIFICATION POLICY - 4. Changes to Number of Guests
The room must hold the new number of guests; children count toward capacity. If it does not, a larger room type must be booked.

BOOKING MODIFICATION POLICY - 5. Extending or Shortening a Stay
Extra nights need the same room to be free, so the guest does not have to change rooms; they are charged at the agreed nightly rate. A stay can be shortened free of charge until 48 hours before arrival. A stay shortened after check-in without notice at check-in is charged one extra night as an early departure fee.

BOOKING MODIFICATION POLICY - 6. Payment After a Change
The first-night deposit already paid stays as it is. Any difference in the total is added to, or taken from, the balance paid at the hotel.

BOOKING MODIFICATION POLICY - 7. Guest Name Changes
The guest name can be changed free of charge until 48 hours before arrival. The new guest must present valid identification at check-in.

BOOKING MODIFICATION POLICY - 8. Bookings Made Through Booking Platforms
Reservations made through a booking platform must be changed or cancelled through that platform, under its terms.

BOOKING MODIFICATION POLICY - 9. How to Make a Change
Log in on the hotel website and ask the voice agent: it checks availability, tells you the new total, and makes the change as soon as you agree. Customer service can also make changes by phone on +20 2 2794 5501 or by email to reservations@nilepearlhotel.example, after the identity check in Reservation Security. Every change is confirmed by email.

BOOKING POLICY - 1. Room Reservations
Guests can reserve any available room. Availability depends on the selected dates and room type. Guests should give accurate booking information.

BOOKING POLICY - 2. Booking Channels
Reservations can be made on the hotel website, by phone on +20 2 2794 5501, by email to reservations@nilepearlhotel.example, through booking platforms, or at reception.

BOOKING POLICY - 3. Information Required
A reservation requires the guest's full name, number of adults and children, check-in and check-out dates, room type, phone number and email address. On the Flexible rate the first night is paid online as a deposit through a secure payment link sent after booking, and the rest is paid at the hotel; the Non-refundable rate is paid in full at booking.

BOOKING POLICY - 4. Room Types and Capacity
Single Room: 1 guest
Double Room: 2 guests
Twin Room: 2 guests
Deluxe Room: 3 guests
Family Room: 4 guests
Suite: 4 guests

Children count toward room capacity. An extra bed costs 2,500 EGP per night and does not raise the room capacity.

BOOKING POLICY - 5. Group Bookings
Bookings of 10 or more rooms receive the group rate, 18% below the Flexible rate. A 30% deposit is due at confirmation and the balance 7 days before arrival. Rooms can be released free of charge until 30 days before arrival; after that the deposit is non-refundable.

BOOKING POLICY - 6. Minimum Age
The guest checking in must be at least 18 years old. Guests under 18 must stay with a parent or guardian.

BOOKING PROCESS - 1. Select Dates
The guest chooses the check-in and check-out dates.

BOOKING PROCESS - 2. Select Room
The guest chooses a room type that fits the number of guests, and a rate plan: Flexible or Non-refundable.

BOOKING PROCESS - 3. Provide Guest Information
The guest gives full name, number of adults and children, phone number and email address.

BOOKING PROCESS - 4. Review Reservation
The guest checks the dates, room type, number of guests, rate plan and total price.

BOOKING PROCESS - 5. Payment
Flexible: the first night is paid online as a deposit through a secure payment link sent by email right after booking; the rest of the stay is paid at the hotel at check-in or check-out. Non-refundable: the full amount is paid through the payment link at booking. The link must be paid within 24 hours, or within 2 hours if arrival is less than 24 hours away; otherwise the booking is cancelled automatically and the room is released.

BOOKING PROCESS - 6. Confirmation
The booking reference is given at once. The booking is confirmed, and the confirmation sent by email, when the payment link is paid.

BOOKING PROCESS - 7. Changes After Booking
Changes and cancellations are handled by customer service according to the Booking Modification and Cancellation policies.

BREAKFAST - 1. Overview
Daily breakfast buffet in the Main Restaurant from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM.

BREAKFAST - 2. Price
1,200 EGP per adult per day; 600 EGP per child aged 6 to 11; free for children under 6. Room rates do not include breakfast unless it was added to the booking.

BREAKFAST - 3. What Is Served
Hot and cold dishes, Egyptian specialities such as foul and taameya, eggs cooked to order, pastries, fresh fruit, juices, tea and coffee. Vegetarian options are always available; vegan and gluten-free options are available on request.

BREAKFAST - 4. Breakfast in the Room
Breakfast can be served in the room through room service at the same price plus the 300 EGP delivery charge.

CANCELLATION POLICY - 1. Flexible Rate
Cancellation is free until 48 hours before 3:00 PM on the arrival date, and the first-night deposit is refunded in full. A later cancellation is charged the first night: the deposit is kept and the remaining nights are not charged.

CANCELLATION POLICY - 2. Non-refundable Rate
Non-refundable reservations are paid in full at booking and are not refunded if cancelled, changed or not used.

CANCELLATION POLICY - 3. Group Bookings
Groups of 10 or more rooms can release rooms free of charge until 30 days before arrival. After that the 30% deposit is non-refundable.

CANCELLATION POLICY - 4. Already Cancelled or Completed Reservations
A cancelled reservation cannot be cancelled again. A completed stay cannot be cancelled; concerns about a completed stay are handled as complaints.

CANCELLATION POLICY - 5. Early Departure
Leaving earlier than booked without telling reception at check-in is charged one extra night.

CANCELLATION POLICY - 6. How to Cancel
Contact customer service with the booking reference. Bookings made through a booking platform are cancelled through that platform. A cancellation confirmation is sent by email.

CANCELLATION PROCESS - 1. Provide Reservation Details
The guest gives the booking reference and the last name on the booking.

CANCELLATION PROCESS - 2. Check the Rate Plan
Customer service checks whether the booking is Flexible or Non-refundable and whether the 48-hour deadline has passed.

CANCELLATION PROCESS - 3. Confirm the Charges
The guest is told before cancelling whether the cancellation is free, costs the first night, or is non-refundable.

CANCELLATION PROCESS - 4. Process the Cancellation
The booking is cancelled and the room released.

CANCELLATION PROCESS - 5. Process Any Refund
Refunds are processed within 3 business days as described in the Refund Policy.

CANCELLATION PROCESS - 6. Keep the Confirmation
A cancellation confirmation is sent by email and should be kept for reference.

CHECK-IN AND CHECK-OUT POLICY - 1. Check-in
Standard check-in time: 3:00 PM. Guests must present valid identification at check-in (see Identification Policy) and the incidentals deposit is taken.

CHECK-IN AND CHECK-OUT POLICY - 2. Early Check-in
From 12:00 PM early check-in is free, subject to room availability. Before 12:00 PM it costs 50% of the nightly rate. To be sure of a room on arrival before 6:00 AM, the previous night must be booked.

CHECK-IN AND CHECK-OUT POLICY - 3. Check-out
Standard check-out time: 12:00 PM.

CHECK-IN AND CHECK-OUT POLICY - 4. Late Check-out
Late check-out is subject to availability: until 4:00 PM it costs 1,500 EGP; until 6:00 PM, 50% of the nightly rate; after 6:00 PM a full night is charged. Silver members may stay until 1:00 PM, Gold until 2:00 PM and Platinum until 4:00 PM free of charge, subject to availability.

CHECK-IN AND CHECK-OUT POLICY - 5. Reception
Hotel reception operates 24/7 and assists with check-in, check-out and general requests.

CHILDREN POLICY - 1. Overview
Children are welcome at the hotel.

CHILDREN POLICY - 2. Guest Capacity Rule
Children count toward room capacity. The total number of guests, adults and children together, must not exceed the capacity of the selected room type. A party larger than four guests requires more than one room, because no room type at Nile Pearl Hotel holds more than four guests.

CHILDREN POLICY - 3. Children's Rates
Children under 6 stay free in the existing beds and have breakfast free. Children aged 6 to 11 pay 600 EGP for breakfast. Guests aged 12 and over pay adult prices.

CHILDREN POLICY - 4. Beds for Children
A baby cot is free on request. An extra bed costs 2,500 EGP per night and does not raise the room capacity.

CHILDREN POLICY - 5. Facilities
Children must be supervised at the pool. Guests under 16 are not admitted to the spa and must be accompanied by an adult in the gym.

COMPLAINTS AND RESOLUTION - 1. Complaint Filing
How to File a Complaint:
Guests can contact the front desk or customer service to file a complaint.

Immediate Issues:
For immediate issues, contact reception (available 24/7).

Post-Stay Complaints:
Complaints after checkout can be submitted through customer service.

Email Complaints:
Detailed complaints can be sent to the hotel's customer service email.

COMPLAINTS AND RESOLUTION - 2. Complaint Categories
Room Quality Issues:
Issues with room condition, cleanliness, or amenities.

Service Issues:
Problems with hotel staff service or responsiveness.

Facility Problems:
Issues with hotel facilities such as Wi-Fi, heating, or plumbing.

Billing Disputes:
Concerns about charges or unexpected fees.

Booking Issues:
Problems related to reservation accuracy or modifications.

COMPLAINTS AND RESOLUTION - 3. Resolution Process
Issue Assessment:
The hotel will assess the complaint and determine the appropriate resolution.

Prompt Response:
Guest complaints are prioritized and addressed promptly.

Resolution Options:
Solutions may include room changes, service compensation, or refunds.

Escalation:
Unresolved issues may be escalated to management.

COMPLAINTS AND RESOLUTION - 4. Service Recovery
Room Changes:
Guests experiencing room issues may be offered alternative accommodation.

Compensation:
The hotel may offer compensation for service failures.

Follow-up:
The hotel may follow up with guests after complaint resolution.

Future Accommodation:
Significant service failures may result in future stay discounts.

COMPLAINTS AND RESOLUTION - 5. Complaint Documentation
Complaint Records:
All complaints are documented for service improvement.

Guest Contact Information:
The hotel maintains contact details for follow-up communication.

Resolution Tracking:
The hotel tracks complaint resolution status.

COMPLAINTS AND RESOLUTION - 6. Important Information
The current hotel knowledge base does not specify detailed compensation amounts for various complaint types.

Guests are encouraged to report issues during their stay for prompt resolution.

Contact customer service for information about specific complaints.

section: 6. Talking to a Member of Staff
text:
CONTACT INFORMATION - 6. Talking to a Member of Staff
Guests who have a problem with their booking or stay can ask the hotel's voice agent to talk to a person at any time. The conversation then continues as a live chat with a member of the hotel staff. If no one is free at that moment, the agent opens an urgent ticket and a member of staff contacts the guest as soon as possible, in the chat or by email.

CONTACT INFORMATION - 7. Important Information
For life-threatening emergencies, contact the Egyptian emergency services directly
rather than the hotel: ambulance 123, police 122, fire 180.

DISCOUNTS AND PROMOTIONS - 1. Special Rates
Non-refundable rate: 15% below the Flexible rate
Early booking (30 or more days ahead): 15% off
Extended stay (7 or more nights): 12% off
Last-minute (within 7 days): up to 25% off, when offered
Loyalty member rate: 15% off
Corporate rate: 13% off for companies with an agreement
Group rate (10 or more rooms): 18% off
Low-season promotions: up to 20% off, when offered

DISCOUNTS AND PROMOTIONS - 2. Promotional Codes
Codes are entered when booking. Each code has validity dates and a usage limit; an expired, not-yet-valid or fully used code cannot be applied. Customer service can check whether a code is valid.

DISCOUNTS AND PROMOTIONS - 3. Terms
Only one discount, code or special rate applies to a booking. Offers are subject to availability and may have blackout dates.

section: 4. Booking With the Hotel's Voice Agent
text:
DISCOUNTS AND PROMOTIONS - 4. Booking With the Hotel's Voice Agent
The voice agent on the hotel website applies only two discounts: the extended-stay discount (7 or more nights) and a valid promotional code. If both apply, the bigger one is used. Member, corporate, group and low-season rates are arranged by the reservations team: the agent records the request and the team replies by email. The agent never gives any other discount. A guest who asks for one can leave a discount request; if the hotel approves it, the guest receives a promotional code by email.

EMERGENCY POLICY - Overview
Overview

In case of an emergency, guests should contact the hotel reception immediately.

Hotel reception operates 24/7.

Guests should follow the instructions provided by hotel staff during an emergency.

For immediate assistance, guests should contact the hotel reception.

EMERGENCY PROCEDURES - 1. Emergency Contact
Emergency numbers in Egypt: ambulance 123, police 122, fire 180. Hotel reception: +20 2 2794 5500, 24/7.

Voice Agent:
If a guest reports an emergency to the hotel's voice agent, the agent gives these numbers at once and alerts the hotel team with a top-priority ticket, so a member of staff responds immediately.

Reception:
Contact hotel reception immediately (available 24/7).

Emergency Telephone:
Use the telephone in your room to contact reception.

Front Desk:
The front desk can provide immediate assistance.

Staff Assistance:
Notify any hotel staff member of emergency situations.

EMERGENCY PROCEDURES - 2. Medical Emergencies
Serious Illness:
Contact reception immediately for medical assistance.

Injury:
Contact reception for immediate first aid and medical services.

Allergic Reaction:
Inform staff immediately of allergic reactions.

Medical Services Arrangement:
The hotel can arrange emergency medical services.

Hospital Contact:
The hotel can contact hospitals and medical facilities.

Doctor Availability:
The hotel can arrange doctor consultation if needed.

EMERGENCY PROCEDURES - 3. Fire Emergency
Alarm System:
Fire alarm systems are monitored 24/7.

Emergency Exits:
Emergency exit routes are clearly marked.

Evacuation Procedures:
Follow staff instructions for evacuation.

Assembly Point:
Guests will be directed to assembly points away from the building.

Stairwell Use:
Use stairs for evacuation (do not use elevators).

Reentry Procedures:
Wait for staff instructions before reentering the building.

EMERGENCY PROCEDURES - 4. Security Issues
Theft or Loss:
Report to reception or front desk immediately.

Lost Items:
Contact the front desk for lost and found services.

Suspicious Activity:
Report suspicious behavior to hotel staff.

Room Security:
Lock doors and use room safes for valuables.

EMERGENCY PROCEDURES - 5. Environmental Issues
Power Outage:
Contact reception for assistance during power failures.

Water Problems:
Report water issues to maintenance immediately.

HVAC Issues:
Report heating or cooling problems immediately.

Damage to Room:
Report any room damage to reception.

EMERGENCY PROCEDURES - 6. Guest-Related Issues
Noise Disturbance:
Contact reception to report noise disturbances.

Unsafe Behavior:
Report unsafe guest behavior to staff.

Conflict Resolution:
Staff can assist with guest conflicts.

EMERGENCY PROCEDURES - 7. Emergency Evacuation
When to Evacuate:
Follow staff instructions for evacuation.

Do Not Use Elevators:
Always use stairs during evacuation.

Assist Others:
Help other guests if safely possible.

Report Location:
Report your location to staff at assembly points.

Wait for Instructions:
Wait for staff instructions before returning to rooms.

EMERGENCY PROCEDURES - 8. Emergency Contact Information
Reception:
Available 24/7 for all emergencies.

Security:
Security personnel are on-site at all times.

Management:
Hotel management can be contacted for serious issues.

External Services:
The hotel can contact police, fire, or ambulance services.

EMERGENCY PROCEDURES - 9. Important Information
In life-threatening emergencies, contact emergency services directly.

Guest safety is the hotel's highest priority.

All staff members are trained in emergency procedures.

Emergency drills are conducted regularly.

Follow all instructions from hotel staff during emergencies.

GUEST CONDUCT - 1. Overview
Guests are expected to respect hotel property, hotel staff and other guests, and to follow hotel rules during their stay.

GUEST CONDUCT - 2. Damage
Damage to hotel property is charged at repair or replacement cost. Guests are responsible for damage caused during their stay.

GYM - 1. Overview
The hotel gym is open 24/7 and is free for hotel guests.

GYM - 2. Equipment
Treadmills, bikes, cross-trainers, free weights and weight machines.

GYM - 3. Rules
Guests under 16 must be accompanied by an adult. Sports shoes are required. No reservation is needed.

HOTEL FACILITIES - 1. Swimming Pool
Open 7:00 AM - 9:00 PM for hotel guests. Towels are provided at the pool. Children must be supervised.

HOTEL FACILITIES - 2. Gym
Open 24/7 and free for hotel guests: cardio machines and free weights. Guests under 16 must be accompanied by an adult.

HOTEL FACILITIES - 3. Wi-Fi
Free in all rooms and public areas, 24/7. The network name and password are printed on the key-card holder given at check-in.

HOTEL FACILITIES - 4. Parking
Free for hotel guests, with valet service at the main entrance 24/7.

HOTEL FACILITIES - 5. Reception
Open 24/7 for check-in, check-out, general requests, hotel services and emergencies.

HOTEL FACILITIES - 6. Room Service
24/7. A 300 EGP delivery charge applies per order, plus menu prices.

HOTEL FACILITIES - 7. Restaurant and Breakfast
Main Restaurant: breakfast 7:00 AM - 10:30 AM (1,200 EGP per adult), lunch 12:30 PM - 4:00 PM, dinner 7:00 PM - 11:00 PM.

HOTEL FACILITIES - 8. Spa
Open 9:00 AM - 10:00 PM. A 60-minute treatment costs 3,500 EGP.

HOTEL FACILITIES - 9. Airport Transfer
Private transfer on request: 2,500 EGP per trip by sedan (up to 3 guests), 4,000 EGP by minivan (up to 6 guests). Book at least 24 hours in advance.

HOTEL INFORMATION - 2. Prices
All prices are in Egyptian Pounds (EGP) and include the 12% service charge, 14% VAT and 1% city tax.

IDENTIFICATION POLICY - 1. Overview
All adult guests must present valid identification at check-in.

IDENTIFICATION POLICY - 2. Accepted Documents
Egyptian nationals: national ID card or passport. Foreign nationals: passport. The hotel registers guests as required by Egyptian regulations.

IDENTIFICATION POLICY - 3. Minimum Age
The guest checking in must be at least 18 years old. Guests under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.

IDENTIFICATION POLICY - 4. Questions
Guests with questions about identification can contact reception.

LAUNDRY AND DRY CLEANING - 1. Price
Laundry and dry cleaning cost 500 EGP per kilogram.

LAUNDRY AND DRY CLEANING - 2. Turnaround
Items handed in before 10:00 AM are returned the same day by 7:00 PM; later items are returned the next day. Express service within 4 hours costs 50% extra.

LAUNDRY AND DRY CLEANING - 3. How to Request
Use the laundry bag in the room and call housekeeping, reception or customer service for collection.

LOCATION AND SURROUNDINGS - 1. Address
Nile Pearl Hotel, 14 Corniche El Nil Street, Garden City, Cairo, Egypt. The hotel stands on the east bank of the Nile in Garden City, a quiet embassy district in central Cairo.

LOCATION AND SURROUNDINGS - 2. Cairo International Airport
The airport is about 25 km from the hotel. The drive usually takes 35 to 60 minutes depending on traffic. The hotel airport transfer costs 2,500 EGP per trip by sedan (up to 3 guests) or 4,000 EGP by minivan (up to 6 guests) and should be booked at least 24 hours in advance.

LOCATION AND SURROUNDINGS - 3. Nearby Landmarks
- Tahrir Square and the Egyptian Museum: about 2 km, 10 minutes by car
- Cairo Tower and Zamalek: about 3 km, 10 to 15 minutes by car
- Khan el-Khalili bazaar and Al-Azhar: about 5 km, 20 minutes by car
- Giza Pyramids: about 17 km, 40 to 60 minutes by car
- Grand Egyptian Museum: about 18 km, 40 to 60 minutes by car

LOCATION AND SURROUNDINGS - 4. Getting Around
The nearest metro stations are Saad Zaghloul and Sadat (Tahrir), both within about 1 km. Reception can call a taxi or a ride-hailing car at any hour. The concierge can recommend tours and restaurants; tour bookings are made with outside operators.

LOCATION AND SURROUNDINGS - 5. Everyday Needs
Pharmacies, ATMs, a supermarket and currency exchange offices are within a 5 to 10 minute walk in Garden City. Reception can give directions at any hour, call a taxi, or arrange pharmacy delivery to the room. For a medical emergency, call reception immediately.

LOST AND FOUND - 1. Overview
Items found on hotel property are handled by the Lost and Found department.

LOST AND FOUND - 2. Reporting a Lost Item
Contact reception with a description of the item and where it was left.

A member earns 1,000 bonus points when a new guest they refer completes a first stay.

NO-SHOW POLICY - 1. Definition
A reservation is recorded as a no-show when the guest does not arrive by the end of the check-in grace period.

NO-SHOW POLICY - 2. Grace Period
A confirmed reservation is held until 23:59 on the scheduled check-in date. After that time, if the guest has not arrived and has not contacted the hotel, the reservation status changes from Confirmed to No-show.

NO-SHOW POLICY - 3. Effect on the Room
Once a reservation becomes a no-show, the room is released back into availability for the remaining nights. The reservation itself is retained in the booking history and is not deleted.

NO-SHOW POLICY - 4. Difference from Cancellation
A cancellation is a reservation the guest withdrew before arrival. A no-show is a reservation the guest neither used nor withdrew. The two are recorded as separate statuses.

NO-SHOW POLICY - 5. Avoiding a No-show
Guests who expect to arrive after 23:59 on the check-in date should inform the hotel in advance; the booking is then held. Reception operates 24 hours a day. Guests who no longer need the reservation should cancel it, because a Flexible booking cancelled at least 48 hours ahead is free.

NO-SHOW POLICY - 6. Charges
Flexible rate: a no-show is charged the first night, which is the deposit already paid; the remaining nights are released and not charged. Non-refundable rate: the full amount is kept.

NOISE POLICY - 1. Overview
Guests should keep noise at a reasonable level and respect other guests.

NOISE POLICY - 2. Quiet Hours
Quiet hours are 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM. Noise can be reported to reception at any hour.

PAYMENT METHODS - 1. Accepted Payment Methods
- Credit and debit cards: Visa, Mastercard and American Express
- Cash in Egyptian Pounds
- Digital wallets: Apple Pay and Vodafone Cash
- Bank transfer, including InstaPay

PAYMENT METHODS - 2. Payment Security
The hotel never asks for full card details by phone, chat, WhatsApp or email. Card details are entered only on the hotel's secure payment page or given in person at reception. The first-night deposit for Flexible bookings is paid through the secure payment link the hotel sends after booking.

PAYMENT METHODS - 3. Currency
Payments are made in Egyptian Pounds. Cards issued abroad are charged in EGP and converted by the card issuer.

PAYMENT METHODS - 4. Payment Assistance
Guests can contact customer service about payment questions or problems.

PAYMENT POLICY - 1. When Payment Is Taken
Flexible rate: the first night is paid online as a deposit through a secure payment link sent after booking, and the rest of the stay is paid at the hotel, at check-in or check-out. Non-refundable rate: the full amount is paid at booking.

PAYMENT POLICY - 2. Incidentals Deposit
Separately from the first-night deposit, at check-in the hotel takes a refundable deposit of 3,000 EGP per night, by card pre-authorisation or in cash, to cover room service and other charges. It is released at check-out.

PAYMENT POLICY - 3. Additional Charges
Services are charged at their listed prices, for example breakfast 1,200 EGP per adult, airport transfer 2,500 EGP per trip, laundry 500 EGP per kilogram and a 60-minute spa treatment 3,500 EGP. Damage to hotel property is charged at repair or replacement cost.

PAYMENT POLICY - 4. Taxes
All prices are in Egyptian Pounds (EGP) and include the 12% service charge, 14% VAT and 1% city tax.

PAYMENT POLICY - 5. Currency
All payments are in Egyptian Pounds. Cards issued abroad are charged in EGP and converted by the card issuer.

PAYMENT POLICY - 6. Payment Problems
If a payment is declined, the guest can use another card or another accepted method through the same payment link, or ask customer service to send a new link; the payment deadline does not change. A booking whose link is not paid within 24 hours (2 hours if arrival is less than 24 hours away) is cancelled automatically. Customer service and reception help with payment problems; billing disputes are handled as complaints.

REFUND POLICY - 1. Refund Eligibility
Flexible bookings cancelled at least 48 hours before arrival get the first-night deposit back in full. Flexible bookings cancelled later, or not used, keep the deposit as the first-night charge and nothing else is charged. Non-refundable bookings are not refunded.

REFUND POLICY - 2. Refund Processing Time
When a Flexible booking is cancelled in time, the first-night deposit is refunded automatically through the payment gateway; no request is needed. The hotel processes approved refunds within 3 business days. A card refund usually appears on the statement 7 to 14 business days later, depending on the bank. Bank transfers, including InstaPay, can take up to 14 business days. Cash payments are refunded in cash at reception or by bank transfer.

REFUND POLICY - 3. Refund Method
Refunds go back to the original payment method.

REFUND POLICY - 4. Incidentals Deposit
The deposit taken at check-in is released at check-out. Cash is returned at once; a card hold is released by the bank within 7 to 14 business days.

REFUND POLICY - 5. Refund Enquiries
Guests can ask customer service for the status of a refund with their booking reference.

RESERVATION SECURITY - 1. Your Account
Guests who are logged in to their account on the hotel website can see and manage the bookings in their account without further questions. Visitors who are not logged in can ask general questions; making or managing a booking and making requests need a login.

RESERVATION SECURITY - 2. Creating an Account
Guests create an account on the hotel website with their email address and a password. A 6-digit code is sent to that email to confirm it: the code works once, for 10 minutes, with up to 5 tries. Hotel staff and the administrator log in on the same page with the accounts the hotel gives them.

RESERVATION SECURITY - 3. Forgotten Password
On the login page, choose "Forgot password". A 6-digit code is sent to the account's email; it works once, for 10 minutes, with up to 5 tries, and then a new password is set. Staff passwords are reset by the hotel administrator.

RESERVATION SECURITY - 4. Emergencies Without a Login
In an emergency the voice agent helps at once, whether or not the caller is logged in: it gives the emergency numbers and alerts the hotel team.

RESERVATION SECURITY - 5. Adding a Booking Made Elsewhere
A booking made by phone, by email, at reception, through a travel agent or through a booking platform can be added to the account once, with the booking reference and one of: the last name on the booking, or the last four digits of the phone number on the booking. It is added only when both match.

Q: Les enfants comptent-ils dans la capacité de la chambre ?
A: Oui. Les enfants comptent dans la capacité. Le total adultes et enfants ne doit pas dépasser la capacité du type choisi : 1 pour une Single, 2 pour une Double ou Twin, 3 pour une Deluxe, 4 pour une Familiale ou une Suite.

Q: Считаются ли дети в вместимость номера?

Q: We are five people. Can we book one room?

Q: Nous sommes cinq. Pouvons-nous réserver une seule chambre ?
A: Aucune chambre ne peut accueillir cinq personnes. Les plus grandes, la Familiale et la Suite, accueillent quatre personnes chacune. Un groupe de cinq ou plus a besoin de plusieurs chambres.

Q: What happens if I do not arrive on my check-in date?
A: Your reservation is held until 23:59 on the check-in date. If you have not arrived and have not contacted the hotel by then, the booking is recorded as a no-show and the room is released. The reservation stays in your history. Reception operates 24/7, so a late arrival can be arranged in advance.

Q: ماذا يحدث إذا لم أصل في تاريخ تسجيل الوصول؟
A: يُحتفظ بحجزك حتى الساعة 23:59 من تاريخ الوصول. وإذا لم تصل ولم تتواصل مع الفندق حتى ذلك الوقت، يُسجَّل الحجز كعدم حضور وتُتاح الغرفة لغيرك، مع بقاء الحجز في سجلك. ومكتب الاستقبال يعمل على مدار الساعة، فيمكن ترتيب الوصول المتأخر مسبقاً.

Q: Что будет, если я не приеду в день заезда?
A: Бронь сохраняется до 23:59 в день заезда. Если вы не приедете и не свяжетесь с отелем до этого времени, бронь фиксируется как неявка, а номер освобождается. Запись остаётся в вашей истории. Рецепция работает круглосуточно, поздний заезд можно согласовать заранее.

Q: What is the difference between cancelling and not showing up?
A: A cancellation is a reservation you withdrew before arrival; a no-show is one you neither used nor withdrew. On the Flexible rate, cancelling at least 48 hours ahead is free, while a no-show is charged the first night, so cancelling in time is better.

Q: Quelle est la différence entre annuler et ne pas se présenter ?
A: Une annulation est une réservation retirée avant l'arrivée ; une non-présentation est une réservation ni utilisée ni annulée. Au tarif flexible, annuler au moins 48 heures à l'avance est gratuit, alors qu'une non-présentation coûte la première nuit : mieux vaut annuler à temps.

Q: В чём разница между отменой и неявкой?
A: Отмена — это бронирование, отозванное до заезда; неявка — бронирование, которое не использовали и не отменили. При гибком тарифе отмена не позднее чем за 48 часов бесплатна, а за неявку взимается первая ночь, поэтому лучше отменить вовремя.

Q: What is the difference between the Flexible and Non-refundable rates?
A: The Flexible rate can be cancelled free of charge until 48 hours before arrival; only the first night is paid online as a deposit and the rest is paid at the hotel. The Non-refundable rate is 15% cheaper but is paid in full at booking and cannot be cancelled, changed or refunded.

Q: ما الفرق بين السعر المرن والسعر غير القابل للاسترداد؟
A: يمكن إلغاء السعر المرن مجاناً حتى 48 ساعة قبل الوصول، وتُدفع فيه الليلة الأولى فقط أونلاين كعربون والباقي في الفندق، أما السعر غير القابل للاسترداد فأقل بنسبة 15% لكنه يُدفع كاملاً عند الحجز ولا يمكن إلغاؤه أو تعديله أو استرداده.

Q: Quelle est la différence entre le tarif flexible et le tarif non remboursable ?
A: Le tarif flexible s'annule gratuitement jusqu'à 48 heures avant l'arrivée ; seule la première nuit est payée en ligne comme acompte et le reste se paie à l'hôtel. Le tarif non remboursable est 15 % moins cher mais se paie intégralement à la réservation et ne peut être ni annulé, ni modifié, ni remboursé.

Q: Чем гибкий тариф отличается от невозвратного?
A: Гибкий тариф можно бесплатно отменить не позднее чем за 48 часов до заезда; онлайн как депозит оплачивается только первая ночь, остальное — в отеле. Невозвратный тариф на 15 % дешевле, но оплачивается полностью при бронировании и не подлежит отмене, изменению или возврату.

Q: إيه الفرق بين السعر المرن واللي مش بيترد؟

Q: أحجز بالسعر الأرخص ولا المرن؟

Q: Do your prices include taxes?
A: Yes. All prices are in Egyptian Pounds and include the 12% service charge, 14% VAT and 1% city tax, so nothing is added at check-out except the services you use.

Q: Vos prix incluent-ils les taxes ?
A: Oui. Tous les prix sont en livres égyptiennes et incluent 12 % de service, 14 % de TVA et 1 % de taxe municipale ; seuls les services utilisés s'ajoutent au départ.

Q: How much does early check-in cost?
A: From 12:00 PM early check-in is free, subject to availability. Before 12:00 PM it costs 50% of the nightly rate, and to be sure of a room on arrival before 6:00 AM the previous night must be booked.

Q: كم تكلفة تسجيل الوصول المبكر؟
A: تسجيل الوصول المبكر مجاني بدءاً من 12:00 ظهراً حسب التوافر، وقبل 12:00 ظهراً يكلف 50% من سعر الليلة، ولضمان الغرفة عند الوصول قبل 6:00 صباحاً يجب حجز الليلة السابقة.

Q: Combien coûte une arrivée anticipée ?
A: À partir de 12h00, l'arrivée anticipée est gratuite selon disponibilité. Avant 12h00, elle coûte 50 % du tarif de la nuit ; pour être sûr d'avoir la chambre avant 6h00, il faut réserver la nuit précédente.

Q: Сколько стоит ранний заезд?
A: С 12:00 ранний заезд бесплатный при наличии номеров. До 12:00 он стоит 50 % стоимости ночи, а чтобы гарантированно заселиться до 6:00, нужно бронировать предыдущую ночь.

Q: How much is late check-out until 6 PM?
A: Late check-out is subject to availability: until 4:00 PM it costs 1,500 EGP, until 6:00 PM 50% of the nightly rate, and after 6:00 PM a full night. Gold members stay until 2:00 PM and Platinum until 4:00 PM free.

Q: كم تكلفة المغادرة المتأخرة حتى السادسة مساءً؟
A: المغادرة المتأخرة حسب التوافر: حتى 4:00 عصراً بسعر 1,500 جنيه مصري، وحتى 6:00 مساءً بنسبة 50% من سعر الليلة، وبعد 6:00 مساءً تُحتسب ليلة كاملة. ويحق لأعضاء المستوى الذهبي البقاء حتى 2:00 ظهراً وللبلاتيني حتى 4:00 عصراً مجاناً.

Q: Combien coûte un départ tardif jusqu'à 18h00 ?
A: Le départ tardif dépend des disponibilités : jusqu'à 16h00 il coûte 1 500 EGP, jusqu'à 18h00 50 % du tarif de la nuit, et après 18h00 une nuit complète. Les membres Gold restent gratuitement jusqu'à 14h00 et Platinum jusqu'à 16h00.

Q: الخروج لحد 6 بالليل بكام؟
A: على حسب المتاح: لحد 4 العصر بـ 1,500 جنيه، ولحد 6 بنص سعر الليلة، وبعد 6 بتتحسب ليلة كاملة. والعضو الدهبي يقدر يفضل لحد 2 الضهر والبلاتيني لحد 4 ببلاش.

Q: أنا عضو دهبي، أقدر أخرج متأخر ببلاش؟
A: على حسب المتاح: لحد 4 العصر بـ 1,500 جنيه، ولحد 6 بنص سعر الليلة، وبعد 6 بتتحسب ليلة كاملة. والعضو الدهبي يقدر يفضل لحد 2 الضهر والبلاتيني لحد 4 ببلاش.

Q: Can I get a room with a Nile view?
A: Yes. A Nile view can be requested free of charge, subject to availability at check-in, or guaranteed for 2,000 EGP per night. All Suites face the Nile.

Q: هل يمكنني الحصول على غرفة مطلة على النيل؟
A: نعم، يمكن طلب الإطلالة على النيل مجاناً حسب التوافر عند تسجيل الوصول، أو ضمانها مقابل 2,000 جنيه مصري لليلة، وجميع الأجنحة مطلة على النيل.

Q: Puis-je avoir une chambre avec vue sur le Nil ?
A: Oui. La vue sur le Nil peut être demandée gratuitement, selon disponibilité à l'arrivée, ou garantie pour 2 000 EGP par nuit. Toutes les suites donnent sur le Nil.

Q: عايز أوضة على النيل
A: أيوة، تقدر تطلب فيو النيل ببلاش على حسب المتاح وقت الدخول، ولو عايز تضمنها بـ 2,000 جنيه زيادة في الليلة. وكل الأجنحة على النيل.

Q: ينفع أختار أوضة فيوها نيل؟
A: أيوة، تقدر تطلب فيو النيل ببلاش على حسب المتاح وقت الدخول، ولو عايز تضمنها بـ 2,000 جنيه زيادة في الليلة. وكل الأجنحة على النيل.

Q: هل يوجد تأمين عند تسجيل الوصول؟
A: نعم، يُؤخذ تأمين مسترد قدره 3,000 جنيه مصري لكل ليلة عند تسجيل الوصول، بحجز مبلغ على البطاقة أو نقداً، ويُفرج عنه عند المغادرة، وقد يستغرق فك الحجز على البطاقة من 7 إلى 14 يوم عمل.

Q: Y a-t-il une caution à l'arrivée ?
A: Oui. Une caution remboursable de 3 000 EGP par nuit est prise à l'arrivée, par pré-autorisation de carte ou en espèces, et libérée au départ ; le blocage sur carte peut mettre 7 à 14 jours ouvrés à disparaître.

Q: Берёте ли вы депозит при заселении?
A: Да. При заселении берётся возвратный депозит 3 000 EGP за ночь — блокировкой на карте или наличными; он снимается при выезде, а блокировка на карте может исчезнуть через 7–14 рабочих дней.

Q: في تأمين وقت الدخول؟ بكام؟
A: أيوة، بناخد تأمين 3,000 جنيه عن كل ليلة وقت الدخول، على الكارت أو كاش، وبيرجع وقت الخروج. لو على الكارت البنك ممكن ياخد من 7 لـ 14 يوم عمل عشان يفكه.

Q: والتأمين ده بيرجع؟
A: أيوة، بناخد تأمين 3,000 جنيه عن كل ليلة وقت الدخول، على الكارت أو كاش، وبيرجع وقت الخروج. لو على الكارت البنك ممكن ياخد من 7 لـ 14 يوم عمل عشان يفكه.

Q: What treatments does the spa offer?
A: The spa is open 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM: a 60-minute massage costs 3,500 EGP, a 90-minute massage 4,800 EGP, a facial 3,000 EGP and an oriental hammam 2,800 EGP. Guests under 16 are not admitted.

Q: ما العلاجات التي يقدمها السبا؟
A: السبا مفتوح من 9:00 صباحاً حتى 10:00 مساءً: مساج 60 دقيقة بسعر 3,500 جنيه مصري، و90 دقيقة بسعر 4,800 جنيه مصري، وعناية بالبشرة بسعر 3,000 جنيه مصري، والحمام الشرقي بسعر 2,800 جنيه مصري، ولا يُسمح بدخول من هم دون 16 عاماً.

Q: Quels soins propose le spa ?
A: Le spa est ouvert de 9h00 à 22h00 : massage de 60 minutes à 3 500 EGP, de 90 minutes à 4 800 EGP, soin du visage à 3 000 EGP et hammam oriental à 2 800 EGP. Interdit aux moins de 16 ans.

Q: What is near the hotel?
A: The hotel is in Garden City on the Nile: Tahrir Square and the Egyptian Museum are about 2 km away, Cairo Tower about 3 km, Khan el-Khalili about 5 km and the Giza Pyramids about 17 km. Saad Zaghloul metro station is within 1 km.

Q: ما المعالم القريبة من الفندق؟
A: يقع الفندق في جاردن سيتي على النيل: ميدان التحرير والمتحف المصري على بعد نحو 2 كم، وبرج القاهرة نحو 3 كم، وخان الخليلي نحو 5 كم، وأهرامات الجيزة نحو 17 كم، ومحطة مترو سعد زغلول على بعد أقل من 1 كم.

Q: Что находится рядом с отелем?
A: Отель расположен в Гарден-Сити на берегу Нила: площадь Тахрир и Египетский музей — примерно в 2 км, Каирская башня — в 3 км, Хан-эль-Халили — в 5 км, пирамиды Гизы — в 17 км. Станция метро Саад Заглюль — менее чем в 1 км.

Q: إيه الأماكن القريبة منكم؟
A: الفندق في جاردن سيتي على النيل: التحرير والمتحف المصري حوالي 2 كيلو، وبرج القاهرة 3 كيلو، وخان الخليلي 5 كيلو، والأهرامات حوالي 17 كيلو يعني من 40 دقيقة لساعة بالعربية، ومترو سعد زغلول أقل من كيلو.

Q: الأهرامات بعيدة عنكم قد إيه؟
A: الفندق في جاردن سيتي على النيل: التحرير والمتحف المصري حوالي 2 كيلو، وبرج القاهرة 3 كيلو، وخان الخليلي 5 كيلو، والأهرامات حوالي 17 كيلو يعني من 40 دقيقة لساعة بالعربية، ومترو سعد زغلول أقل من كيلو.

Q: What do you need to check my booking details?
A: If you are logged in, the bookings in your account need nothing more. To add a booking made by phone, through an agency or a booking platform, we need the booking reference and either the last name on the booking or the last four digits of the phone number on it. We never ask for full card numbers or card security codes.

Q: ما المطلوب للاطلاع على تفاصيل حجزي؟
A: إذا كنت مسجلاً الدخول فلا نحتاج إلى أي بيانات إضافية للحجوزات الموجودة في حسابك. ولإضافة حجز تم عبر الهاتف أو وكالة سفر أو منصة حجز، نحتاج إلى رقم الحجز مع اسم العائلة المسجل في الحجز أو آخر أربعة أرقام من الهاتف المسجل، ولا نطلب أبداً رقم البطاقة كاملاً أو رمزها الأمني.

Q: De quoi avez-vous besoin pour consulter ma réservation ?
A: Si vous êtes connecté, les réservations de votre compte ne demandent rien de plus. Pour ajouter une réservation faite par téléphone, par une agence ou une plateforme de réservation, il nous faut le numéro de réservation et soit le nom de famille de la réservation, soit les quatre derniers chiffres du téléphone indiqué. Nous ne demandons jamais le numéro complet ni le code de sécurité de votre carte.

Q: Что нужно, чтобы узнать детали моей брони?
A: Если вы вошли в аккаунт, для броней в нём больше ничего не нужно. Чтобы добавить бронь, сделанную по телефону, через агентство или платформу бронирования, нужны номер брони и либо фамилия из брони, либо последние четыре цифры указанного в ней телефона. Мы никогда не запрашиваем полный номер карты или её код безопасности.

Q: محتاجين إيه عشان تقولولي تفاصيل حجزي؟
A: لو انت عامل لوجين، الحجوزات اللي في حسابك مش محتاجة أي حاجة زيادة. ولو عايز تضيف حجز عملته بالتليفون أو من شركة سياحة أو من Booking.com، محتاجين رقم الحجز ومعاه اسم العيلة اللي في الحجز أو آخر 4 أرقام من التليفون المسجل. وإحنا عمرنا ما بنطلب رقم الكارت كامل أو الرقم السري بتاعه، فلو حد طلبه كلّم الاستقبال على ‎+20 2 2794 5500.

Q: حد كلمني من الفندق وطلب رقم الكارت كامل، ده طبيعي؟
A: لو انت عامل لوجين، الحجوزات اللي في حسابك مش محتاجة أي حاجة زيادة. ولو عايز تضيف حجز عملته بالتليفون أو من شركة سياحة أو من Booking.com، محتاجين رقم الحجز ومعاه اسم العيلة اللي في الحجز أو آخر 4 أرقام من التليفون المسجل. وإحنا عمرنا ما بنطلب رقم الكارت كامل أو الرقم السري بتاعه، فلو حد طلبه كلّم الاستقبال على ‎+20 2 2794 5500.

Q: What is the minimum age to check in?
A: The guest checking in must be at least 18 years old. Guests under 18 must stay with a parent or guardian.

Q: ما الحد الأدنى لسن تسجيل الوصول؟
A: يجب ألا يقل عمر النزيل الذي يسجل الوصول عن 18 عاماً، ويجب أن يرافق من هم دون 18 عاماً أحد الوالدين أو وصي.

Q: Quel est l'âge minimum pour l'enregistrement ?
A: La personne qui s'enregistre doit avoir au moins 18 ans. Les moins de 18 ans doivent séjourner avec un parent ou un tuteur.

Q: С какого возраста можно заселиться?
A: Заселяющийся гость должен быть не младше 18 лет. Гости младше 18 лет проживают с родителем или опекуном.

Q: لازم يكون عندي كام سنة عشان أحجز أوضة؟
A: اللي بيعمل check-in لازم يكون 18 سنة أو أكتر، واللي أقل من 18 لازم يبقى معاه حد من أهله أو ولي أمره.

Q: ابني عنده 17 سنة، ينفع ينزل لوحده؟
A: اللي بيعمل check-in لازم يكون 18 سنة أو أكتر، واللي أقل من 18 لازم يبقى معاه حد من أهله أو ولي أمره.

Q: Servez-vous de l'alcool ?
A: Non. Le Nile Pearl Hotel ne sert pas de boissons alcoolisées ; le restaurant et le room service proposent sodas, jus frais, thé et café.

Q: Подаёте ли вы алкоголь?
A: Нет. В Nile Pearl Hotel не подают алкогольные напитки; ресторан и обслуживание номеров предлагают безалкогольные напитки, свежие соки, чай и кофе.

Q: عندكم بيرة أو مشروبات كحولية؟
A: لأ، الفندق مش بيقدم مشروبات كحولية ومفيش بار. المطعم والروم سيرفس فيهم عصاير فريش وشاي وقهوة ومياه غازية.

Q: في بار في الفندق؟
A: لأ، الفندق مش بيقدم مشروبات كحولية ومفيش بار. المطعم والروم سيرفس فيهم عصاير فريش وشاي وقهوة ومياه غازية.

Q: كم عدد غرف الفندق؟
A: يضم Nile Pearl Hotel 150 غرفة وجناحاً موزعة على 15 طابقاً من الطابق الثاني حتى السادس عشر، والكثير منها يطل على النيل، وجميع الأجنحة مطلة على النيل.

Q: Combien de chambres compte l'hôtel ?
A: Le Nile Pearl Hotel compte 150 chambres et suites réparties sur 15 étages, du 2e au 16e. Beaucoup donnent sur le Nil, et toutes les suites ont vue sur le Nil.

Q: Сколько номеров в отеле?
A: В Nile Pearl Hotel 150 номеров и люксов на 15 этажах, со 2-го по 16-й. Многие номера выходят на Нил, а все люксы — с видом на Нил.

Q: Is there a pharmacy or an ATM near the hotel?
A: Yes. Pharmacies, ATMs, a supermarket and currency exchange offices are within a 5 to 10 minute walk in Garden City. Reception can give directions at any hour or arrange pharmacy delivery to your room.

Q: هل توجد صيدلية أو ماكينة صراف آلي قرب الفندق؟
A: نعم، توجد صيدليات وماكينات صراف آلي وسوبر ماركت ومكاتب صرافة على بُعد 5 إلى 10 دقائق سيراً في جاردن سيتي، ويمكن للاستقبال إرشادك في أي وقت أو ترتيب توصيل الأدوية إلى غرفتك.

Q: Есть ли рядом с отелем аптека или банкомат?
A: Да. Аптеки, банкоматы, супермаркет и обменные пункты находятся в 5–10 минутах ходьбы в районе Гарден-Сити. Ресепшен в любое время подскажет дорогу или организует доставку лекарств в номер.

Q: فين أقرب صيدلية؟
A: في صيدليات ومكن ATM وسوبر ماركت ومكاتب صرافة على بعد 5 لـ 10 دقايق مشي في جاردن سيتي. الاستقبال يوصفلك الطريق في أي وقت، أو يطلبلك الدوا يوصل لحد الأوضة.

Q: في ATM قريب من الفندق أغيّر منه فلوس؟
A: في صيدليات ومكن ATM وسوبر ماركت ومكاتب صرافة على بعد 5 لـ 10 دقايق مشي في جاردن سيتي. الاستقبال يوصفلك الطريق في أي وقت، أو يطلبلك الدوا يوصل لحد الأوضة.

Q: What happens if I don't pay the payment link right away?
A: Your booking is held until the payment link is paid: 24 hours, or 2 hours if you arrive in less than 24 hours. Once it is paid the booking is confirmed by email; if it is not paid in time, the booking is cancelled automatically and the room is released.

Q: ماذا يحدث إذا لم أدفع رابط الدفع فوراً؟
A: يبقى الحجز محجوزاً لك حتى يتم دفع رابط الدفع: لمدة 24 ساعة، أو ساعتين إذا كان وصولك بعد أقل من 24 ساعة. وبعد الدفع يتأكد الحجز ويصلك التأكيد بالبريد الإلكتروني، وإذا لم يُدفع الرابط في الوقت المحدد يُلغى الحجز تلقائياً وتُتاح الغرفة لغيرك.

Q: Que se passe-t-il si je ne paie pas tout de suite le lien de paiement ?
A: Votre réservation est bloquée jusqu'au paiement du lien : 24 heures, ou 2 heures si vous arrivez dans moins de 24 heures. Une fois le paiement reçu, la réservation est confirmée par e-mail ; sinon, elle est annulée automatiquement et la chambre est libérée.

Q: Что будет, если я не оплачу ссылку сразу?
A: Бронь удерживается до оплаты ссылки: 24 часа или 2 часа, если вы приезжаете менее чем через 24 часа. После оплаты бронь подтверждается письмом на почту; если ссылка не оплачена вовремя, бронь отменяется автоматически, и номер освобождается.

Q: لو مادفعتش اللينك على طول الحجز هيتلغي؟
A: الحجز بيفضل محجوزلك لحد ما تدفع اللينك: 24 ساعة، أو ساعتين بس لو وصولك بعد أقل من 24 ساعة. أول ما تدفع الحجز بيتأكد ويوصلك إيميل، ولو مادفعتش في الوقت ده الحجز بيتلغي لوحده والأوضة بتتاح لحد تاني.

Q: الكارت اترفض وأنا بدفع العربون، الحجز راح؟
A: لأ، الحجز مش بيتلغي عشان الكارت اترفض. ادفع بكارت تاني أو أي طريقة تانية من نفس اللينك، أو اطلب لينك جديد من خدمة العملاء، بس آخر ميعاد للدفع زي ما هو.

Q: Can I talk to a real person instead of the assistant?
A: Yes. If you have a problem, ask the assistant to talk to a person at any time and the conversation continues as a live chat with a member of staff. If no one is free at that moment, an urgent ticket is opened and a member of staff contacts you as soon as possible, in the chat or by email.

Q: هل يمكنني التحدث مع موظف بدلاً من المساعد؟
A: نعم. إذا كانت لديك مشكلة يمكنك أن تطلب من المساعد التحدث مع شخص في أي وقت، فتستمر المحادثة كدردشة مباشرة مع أحد موظفي الفندق. وإذا لم يكن هناك موظف متاح في تلك اللحظة، تُفتح تذكرة عاجلة ويتواصل معك أحد الموظفين في أقرب وقت عبر المحادثة أو البريد الإلكتروني.

Q: Puis-je parler à une vraie personne au lieu de l'assistant ?
A: Oui. Si vous avez un problème, demandez à tout moment à l'assistant de parler à une personne : la conversation se poursuit alors en chat en direct avec un membre du personnel. Si personne n'est disponible à ce moment-là, un ticket urgent est ouvert et un membre du personnel vous contacte dès que possible, dans le chat ou par e-mail.

Q: Могу ли я поговорить с живым человеком вместо помощника?
A: Да. Если у вас проблема, в любой момент попросите помощника соединить вас с человеком — разговор продолжится в живом чате с сотрудником отеля. Если в этот момент никто не свободен, открывается срочная заявка, и сотрудник свяжется с вами как можно скорее в чате или по электронной почте.

Q: عايز أكلم حد من الموظفين مش البوت
A: أكيد. لو عندك مشكلة اطلب تكلم موظف في أي وقت، والمحادثة هتكمل شات لايف مع حد من فريق الفندق. ولو مفيش حد فاضي الدقيقة دي، بنفتح تيكت مستعجل وحد من الموظفين هيكلمك في أقرب وقت في الشات أو على الإيميل.

Q: What should I do in an emergency while I am talking to the assistant?
A: Call for help right away: ambulance 123, police 122, fire 180, or hotel reception on +20 2 2794 5500, available 24/7. If you tell the assistant about an emergency, it gives you these numbers and alerts the hotel team at once with a top-priority ticket.

Q: ماذا أفعل في حالة طارئة أثناء التحدث مع المساعد؟
A: اطلب المساعدة فوراً: الإسعاف 123، والشرطة 122، والمطافئ 180، أو استقبال الفندق على ‎+20 2 2794 5500 على مدار الساعة. وإذا أخبرت المساعد بحالة طارئة، يعطيك هذه الأرقام وينبّه فريق الفندق فوراً بتذكرة ذات أولوية قصوى.

Q: Que faire en cas d'urgence pendant que je parle à l'assistant ?
A: Demandez de l'aide tout de suite : ambulance 123, police 122, pompiers 180, ou la réception de l'hôtel au +20 2 2794 5500, 24h/24. Si vous signalez une urgence à l'assistant, il vous donne ces numéros et alerte immédiatement l'équipe de l'hôtel avec un ticket de priorité maximale.

Q: Что делать в экстренной ситуации во время разговора с помощником?
A: Сразу вызывайте помощь: скорая 123, полиция 122, пожарные 180 или ресепшен отеля +20 2 2794 5500, круглосуточно. Если вы сообщите помощнику о чрезвычайной ситуации, он назовёт эти номера и сразу оповестит команду отеля заявкой с наивысшим приоритетом.

Q: في حالة طوارئ أعمل إيه؟
A: اطلب المساعدة على طول: الإسعاف 123، والشرطة 122، والمطافي 180، أو استقبال الفندق على ‎+20 2 2794 5500 شغال 24 ساعة. ولو قلت للمساعد إن فيه طوارئ، هيديك الأرقام دي ويبلّغ فريق الفندق فوراً بتيكت أولويته قصوى.

Q: How do I create an account on your website?
A: Sign up on the hotel website with your email address and a password. We email you a 6-digit code to confirm the address: it works once, for 10 minutes, with up to 5 tries. Once you are logged in, you can book and manage your bookings.

Q: كيف أنشئ حساباً على موقعكم؟
A: سجّل في موقع الفندق ببريدك الإلكتروني وكلمة مرور، وسنرسل إليك رمزاً من 6 أرقام لتأكيد البريد: يُستخدم مرة واحدة خلال 10 دقائق، مع 5 محاولات كحد أقصى. وبعد تسجيل الدخول يمكنك الحجز وإدارة حجوزاتك.

Q: إزاي أعمل حساب على الموقع بتاعكم؟
A: سجّل في موقع الفندق بإيميلك وباسورد، وهيوصلك كود من 6 أرقام تأكّد بيه الإيميل: شغال مرة واحدة لمدة 10 دقايق، وليك 5 محاولات بالكتير. وبعد ما تعمل لوجين تقدر تحجز وتتابع حجوزاتك.

Q: I forgot my password. What should I do?
A: Choose "Forgot password" on the login page. A 6-digit code is sent to your account's email: it works once, for 10 minutes, with up to 5 tries. Then you set a new password. The hotel never asks for your password by phone, chat or email.

Q: نسيت كلمة المرور، ماذا أفعل؟
A: اختر «نسيت كلمة المرور» في صفحة الدخول، فيصلك رمز من 6 أرقام على بريد حسابك: يُستخدم مرة واحدة خلال 10 دقائق، مع 5 محاولات كحد أقصى، ثم تضع كلمة مرور جديدة. ولا يطلب الفندق كلمة المرور أبداً بالهاتف أو المحادثة أو البريد الإلكتروني.

Q: نسيت الباسورد بتاعي، أعمل إيه؟
A: دوس على «نسيت الباسورد» في صفحة الدخول، وهيوصلك كود من 6 أرقام على إيميل الحساب: شغال مرة واحدة لمدة 10 دقايق، وليك 5 محاولات بالكتير، وبعدها تعمل باسورد جديد. والفندق عمره ما بيطلب منك الباسورد في تليفون أو شات أو إيميل.

Q: Do I need an account to book with the hotel's assistant?
A: Yes. Without logging in you can ask general questions about the hotel. To book, see or change a booking, or make a request, you log in first; a booking made by phone, through an agency or on a booking platform can then be added with its reference and the last name on it. In an emergency the assistant helps at once, with or without a login.

Q: هل أحتاج إلى حساب للحجز مع مساعد الفندق؟
A: نعم. دون تسجيل الدخول يمكنك طرح الأسئلة العامة عن الفندق، أما الحجز أو الاطلاع على حجز أو تعديله أو تقديم طلب فيحتاج إلى تسجيل الدخول أولاً، ويمكن بعدها إضافة حجز تم بالهاتف أو عبر وكالة أو منصة حجز برقمه واسم العائلة المسجل عليه. وفي حالات الطوارئ يساعدك المساعد فوراً، سجّلت الدخول أم لا.

Q: لازم أعمل حساب عشان أحجز مع المساعد بتاعكم؟
A: أيوه. من غير لوجين تقدر تسأل أي سؤال عام عن الفندق، لكن الحجز أو إنك تشوف حجز أو تعدّله أو تطلب حاجة محتاج لوجين الأول، وبعدها تقدر تضيف حجز عملته بالتليفون أو من شركة سياحة أو موقع حجز برقمه واسم العيلة اللي عليه. ولو في طوارئ المساعد بيساعدك على طول، عامل لوجين أو لأ.
